content:
Overview

Eldoret is a city in Uasin Gishu with a population of 475,000. A major city in the Rift Valley, known as a center for athletics and the ‘Home of Champions’ for Kenyan runners. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
